privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use the Horoscope app.

birthInformation.title: Birth Information
birthInformation.purpose: To generate accurate horoscope readings and astrological charts

profilePhotos.title: Profile Photos
profilePhotos.purpose: To personalize your account and enhance user experience

handPhotos.title: Hand Photos
handPhotos.purpose: To provide palm reading analysis and interpretations

accountInformation.title: Account Information
accountInformation.purpose: To manage your account and communicate important updates

paymentInformation.title: Payment Information
paymentInformation.purpose: To process premium subscription purchases through Google Play

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us when using the Horoscope app. This includes personal data necessary for providing astrological services and enhancing your experience.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.content: Your birth information (date, time, and place) is used exclusively to generate personalized horoscopes, zodiac reports, and astrological insights. Profile photos are optional and stored securely on our servers. Hand photos submitted for palmistry readings are processed using our analysis algorithms and stored encrypted. We never share your personal photos with third parties.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Hand photos and profile pictures are stored on secure servers with restricted access. We regularly update our security protocols to ensure your data remains protected.

premiumSubscriptions.title: Premium Subscriptions
premiumSubscriptions.content: Our premium subscription is processed through Google Play Store. We do not store your credit card or payment information directly. All payment processing is handled securely by Google Play. Your subscription information (active status, purchase date) is stored to manage your premium features access.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time through the app settings or by contacting us. Upon deletion request, all your data including birth information, photos, and readings will be permanently removed within 30 days.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. You can download a copy of your data, request corrections, or permanently delete your account. For premium subscribers, you can cancel your subscription through Google Play Store at any time.

thirdPartyServices.title: Third-Party Services
thirdPartyServices.content: We use Google Play Store for payment processing and may use analytics services to improve app performance. These services have their own privacy policies. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.content: Our app is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us immediately.

changesToPolicy.title: Changes to Privacy Policy
changesToPolicy.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes through the app or via email. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

keyPoints.title: Your Data is Safe With Us

contact.title: Questions About Privacy?
contact.subtitle: We're here to help. Contact our privacy team anytime.
